quarterly_data.signal: Palo Alto Networks acquired Console, an AI-native platform for agentic workflows built in natural language, to deepen agentic capabilities in Cortex so customers can investigate signals and alert on and remediate issues automatically. CEO Nikesh Arora calls it the shift to 'software-as-an-agent'.
